title: Enhancement: Additional DNS configuration options
author: bhouse-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Common DNS configuration options are missing from SONiC, we need to add these to support more deployments.

### Current Behavior

Missing additional configuration knobs

### Proposed Behavior

Add knobs for:
 * search
 * ndots
 * timeout
 * attempts

### Implementation
* https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/pull/1975
* https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22310
* https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-host-services/pull/239

linkedPullRequests.title: Monitor DNS_OPTIONS for changes
linkedPullRequests.author: bhouse-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
A new DNS_OPTIONS table has been added to allow for more than basic nameserver configuration.  We need to monitor this table for changes like we do DNS_NAMESERVER and simply reload the DNS configuration service when changes are detected.

Depends on https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22310

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22311

**NOTE**: There are no tests in `sonic-host-services` for DNS as all it is doing is restarting a daemon which regenerates the `/etc/resolv.conf`.  This daemon is in `sonic-buildimage`.

comments.author: bhouse-nexthop
comments.body:
> @bhouse-nexthop yes. But we probably some unit test to clear the PR check first.

I honestly don't see how we could write a test case for this.  The existing DNS nameserver changes also don't have tests. All this does is restarts the service responsible for generating the `/etc/resolv.conf` when the config is detected to have changed.  Since that daemon resides within sonic-buildimage and not sonic-host-services, there's no way to validate the configuration that is generated by the changes or anything like that.
